column1: # Tarleaks ERP — apps that are not in every release: the first release that
# publishes their image and, when an app was taken out again, the first release
# WITHOUT it. An app not listed here exists in every release. The installers and
# ./tarleaks leave an app out of the presets, and refuse it by name, while
# TARLEAKS_VERSION is outside that range: its image does not exist, so
# downloading would fail. An installation that ran a withdrawn app keeps its
# data; the app is simply not started on that release.
# Diagram Studio (`diagrams`) is not listed: it is back, and exists in every
# release this kit installs from 1.2.0-rc.3 on. (1.2.0-rc.1 and rc.2 left it out
# while it was rebuilt; their images do not have it, so do not install them
# with this revision.) The rewrite generates inside the `diagrams` image, so
# there is no separate AI engine.
# app            first release   withdrawn in (optional; an editor of kind addon in apps.tsv counts as an app here)
